record.question: Nursing Superintendent is responsible for:
options: Planning and implementing quality medical care as required by the institution
Administration of medicines as per medication order and record entry
record.explanation: Answer C: Planning and implementing quality medical care as required by the institution. A Nursing Superintendent oversees nursing services and plans and implements the standard of nursing/medical care required by the institution. Source/context note: Exact job description varies by hospital. Reference: https://www.nabh.co/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
